objective: Custom Blender models for Neon Spire, made with the proven Night pipeline: a plan of every visual, procedural headless Blender scripts with a one-command rebuild, committed FBX/PNG exports, the upload workflow generalised to night or spire, and the Spire code reading one SpireAssets table with today's part visuals as the fallback while ids are nil.
inputs: Owner request 2026-10-27 (custom Blender models, as for Hundred Demon Night)
acceptance_criteria: docs/assets/spire-blender-plan.md lists every Spire visual with its source, size, tri budget and priority, and the ones that stay procedural
tools/blender/spire/build.py rebuilds every asset headless in Blender 5.2; assets/spire/ holds <asset>.fbx and <asset>.png for each manifest asset; the contact sheet was reviewed
.github/workflows/upload-assets.yml takes game night or spire and publishes tools/blender/<game>/uploaded.json and the matching assets module; the Night path still works
src/shared/SpireAssets.luau is generated by tools/blender/write-assets-module.mjs spire; with nil ids the game runs exactly as before
docs/assets/register.md has a Pending upload row per Spire asset
verification: lune run tests/run, selene src, stylua --check on changed files, rojo build spire.project.json and night.project.json, node tools/validate-tasks.mjs; contact sheet review; after the upload run, playtest Spire with the generated SpireAssets.luau
output_artifacts: src/relay/Models.luau, src/spire/*.luau, src/spire-client/Kit.luau, City.client.luau, PlazaView.client.luau, TowerView.client.luau
notes: Decision 0010 on this branch still defers Blender (option C); the owner asked for it directly. Upload is run by the Director after merge (environment assets, CLAUDE.md rules 6 and 7). Vehicles are built but not wired until Traffic.client.luau exists.
